purpose: SYNTHETIC development benchmark dataset for the FINACE ML risk prediction layer. NOT regulatory ground truth.

label_rulebook.purpose: Synthetic benchmark/development labels for exercising the ML risk layer. Not real regulatory ground truth.
label_rulebook.equation: z = BASE + W_HIGH_GAP*high_gaps + W_MEDIUM_GAP*medium_gaps + W_EXPOSURE*exposures + W_MISSING_CONTROL*missing_controls + W_INACTIVE_EVIDENCE*(1-active_ratio) + latent + noise
label_rulebook.on_label_distribution: Because z starts at BASE_RISK=0.10 and only gains ~0.28 per HIGH gap, scenarios with no triggered rules and good controls land in LOW, while scenarios with multiple HIGH gaps land in HIGH; the boundary band is noisy.

notes: workflow_description is generated from a flag-matched vocabulary so the live rule engine and the online feature extractor reproduce the row.
retrieval metrics are sampled (synthetic); at serving time they are measured from LocalRetriever.search output.
